chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from some of our companions, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
"If you gain power over the thief, then strike before he does; I am your partner in his blood."

key_terms.اللِّصِّ: the thief; the aggressor being confronted
key_terms.دَمِهِ: his blood; meaning liability for his killing
key_terms.شَرِيكُكَ: your partner; sharing responsibility with you
key_terms.فَابْدُرْهُ: then hasten against him first; take action before he does
key_terms.قَدَرْتَ: you were able; having the capacity or power to act

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about killing a thief in self-defense?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning confronting a thief when one is able to overpower him. It indicates authorization for preemptive defensive action in such a case, with the Imam عليه السلام assuming responsibility regarding the bloodshed that results.
